messages:
maya: Heads-up — we need a compact compatibility matrix + rollout flow for VPC/on-prem customers who want to stay on minor releases (eg. 1.4.x) but still get security patches. Asking for: customer ops playbook, UX for pinning minor versions, and supported-networking combos.
liam: +1. main ask from sales/field is: predictable upgrade surface and a clear downgrade/rollback path for minor bumps.
sophia: Field note: customers often insist on pinning to a minor version for validation cycles. they expect us to push critical patches without changing major/minor semantics.
raj: engineer view: feasible options — (A) hotpatch artifacts that only change base images/config, (B) patch channel that applies security-only manifests, (C) automated patch bundles with opt-in. each has infra + testing cost.
jamie-devx: UX idea: in Console > Deployments add: "Minor pinning" toggle + "Apply security-only patches" checkbox. default off for new installs, opt-in for reserved customers. show last-patched timestamp.
maya: can we sketch a tiny matrix now? helps prioritize.
liam: sure, quick draft:
```
Compatibility matrix (proposal)
- Bundle type: full-upgrade | security-patch-only | hotpatch layer
- When to use: major/minor bump | critical CVE or dependency patch | tiny runtime fixes
- Customer opt-in: no | optional (recommended) | optional
- Downgrade path: full rollback required | config revert | layer revert

Targeted networking combos:
- VPC peering + private subnet: supported for all bundles
- On-prem VPN (customer NAT): supported for full-upgrade & security-patch-only
- Air-gapped (offline): only full-upgrade via offline bundle
```
raj: add testing column: e2e smoke + k8s operator lifecycle + network handshake tests. air-gapped requires manual acceptance tests.
sophia: deployment playbook (field):
- Step 1: customer signs minor-pinning SLO
- Step 2: schedule maintenance window for any full-upgrade
- Step 3: if security-patch-only chosen, confirm images checksums + canary on 1 host
- Step 4: telemetry hooks enabled + rollback criteria documented

jamie-devx: quick CLI snippet for patch opt-in:
```bash
redwoodctl release patch-apply --cluster my-corp --channel security-only --canary 1
```
maya: acceptance criteria for rollout readiness?
liam: minimal: docs (playbook + matrix) published, Console toggle + API flag exist behind feature-flag, one internal canary pass on staging, support runbook with automated rollback steps.
raj: engineering effort estimate: patch channel + operators ~ 3 sprints (2 backend, 1 infra), Console + API flags ~ 1 sprint (devx + FE). testing infra (airgap harness) extra spike.
sophia: customer comms: prepare a short email template + in-console banner explaining what "security-only" means and how to opt-out. include expected downtime for full-upgrade.
maya: blockers?
raj: main blocker is image signing + provenance flow for security-only layers. need to ensure we can sign hotpatch artifacts so on-prem customers accept them.
jamie-devx: propose feature-flag rollout: start with Dedicated customers then expand to Private. gives time to validate signatures + canary metrics.
eng-bot: Deployment note: nightly-builds/patch-channel pipeline created (id: patch-ci-202).
liam: next steps: 1) finalize matrix and playbook (owner: maya), 2) spike image-signing + airgap test (owner: raj), 3) Console flag PR (owner: jamie-devx). target: ship internal beta in 6 weeks.
sophia: tagging for customer trials — i will collect 2 pilot customers this week.
maya: great. i'll draft the doc and post link here when ready. :thumbsup:
